questions.q_en: A, B, C and D invested Rs 20000, Rs 30000, Rs 30000 and Rs 10000 respectively for time period in the ratio 1/3 : 1/6 : 1/6 : 1/2. If the value of C's share in profit is Rs 30000, what is the value of total profit?
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of investments of A, B, C and D = 20000:30000:30000:10000

or, 2:3:3:1

Ratio of time periods = 1/3 : 1/6 : 1/6 : 1/2 or, 2:1:1:3

Profit will be shared in the ratio (2*2) : (3*1) : (3*1) : (1*3) or, 4:3:3:3

Let the total profit be Rs 'x'.

C's share = (3/13)*x = 30,000

=> x = Rs 1.3 Lakh

questions.q_en: A bus travels at 100 km/h for the first 30 Minutes. Later it travels at 80 km/h. Find the time taken by the bus to travel 290 km.
questions.solution_en:
The distance covered by the bus at 100 km/h in first 1/2 hour = 100 * (1/2) = 50 km

The distance covered by the bus at 80 km/h = 290 - 50 = 240 km

The time taken to covered 240 km at 80 km/h = 240/80 = 3 km/h

So, the time taken by the bus to travel 290 km = 3 + 1/2 = 3.5 hours

M, N, and O run simultaneously, starting from a point, around a circular track of length 1600 m, at respective speeds of 3 m/s, 7 m/s, and 11 m/s. M and N run in the same direction, while O runs in the opposite direction to the other two. After how much time will they meet for the first time?
questions.solution_en:
Relative speed of M and O = 11 + 3 = 14 m/s

Relative speed of N and O = 11 + 7 = 18 m/s

Net relative speed = 18 - 14 = 4 m/s

Time taken by them to meet for the first time = 1600/4 = 400 sec = 6 minutes 40 seconds

questions.q_en: What is the sum of unit digit of 40321 and 30943?
questions.solution_en:
The concept of cyclicity is used to identify the last digit of the number.

Cyclicity chart:

NumberCyclicityUnit digit values
Power 1Power 2Power 3Power 4
010
111
242486
343971
4246
515
616
747931
848426
9291

(Note: when remainder is 0, power = cyclicity)

In 40321:

Unit digit of 403 is 3.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 3 is 4.

So, we have to divide the power of 403 i.e.21 by 4.

After dividing 21 by 4, remainder = 1. So, power ≠ cyclicity

Unit digit of 31 = 3

In 30943:

Unit digit of 309 is 9.

From the cyclicity chart, cyclicity of 9 is 2.

So, we have to divide the power of 309 i.e. 43 by 2.

After dividing 43 by 2, remainder = 1. So, power ≠ cyclicity

In this case, unit digit of 91 = 9

Therefore, sum of unit digit of 40321 and 30943 = 3 + 9 = 12

questions.q_en: Rohan borrowed Rs. 60000 at 20% per annum compounded half-yearly for 1(1/2) years. If he paid Rs. 45000 at the end of one year, then how much amount of money he paid at the end of 1(1/2) years?
questions.solution_en:
P = Rs. 60000

R = 21% per annum

T = 3/2 years

Amount after 1 year = 60000 * (1 + 20/200)2 = Rs. 72600

He paid Rs. 45000

So, left amount = 72600 - 45000 = 27600

So, amount paid at the end of 1(1/2) years = 27600 * (1 + 20/200) = Rs. 30360

questions.q_en: Train A takes 35 minutes more than train B to travel a distance of 460 km. Due to engine trouble speed of train B falls by a quarter, so it takes 30 minutes more than train A to complete the same journey. What is the speed of train A (in km/hr)?
questions.solution_en:
Speed ratio of train B = 4: 3

So, the time ratio of train B = 3: 4

Time difference between train A and B = 35 + 30 = 65 minutes

Time taken by train A = 65 * 3 + 35 = 230 min = 23/6 hours

Speed of train A = 460 * 6/23 = 120 km/hr

questions.q_en: Find the remainder, if 19200 is divided by 20.
questions.solution_en:
We are given a = 19 and n = 20. Since 19 and 20 are coprime (gcd(19, 20) = 1), Euler's Theorem can be applied.

First, we calculate φ(20):

20 can be factored as 20 = 2² X 5, so:

φ(20) = 20 X (1 - 1/2) X (1 - 1/5) = 20 X 1/2 X 4/5 = 8

According to Euler's Theorem, we know:

198 ≡ 1 (mod 20).

Now, we want to calculate 19200 mod 20. We can write 200 as a multiple of 8 plus a remainder:

200 = 8 X 25, so:

19200 = (198)25.

Since 198 ≡ 1 (mod 20), we have:

19200 = (1)25 ≡ 1 (mod 20).
